elements.element: Restriction is mutual (binds Vendor as well as Customer)
elements.evidence: "This restriction is mutual and applies equally to Vendor in respect of Customer personnel"

elements.element: Scope limited to personnel directly involved in the services
elements.evidence: "is limited to personnel directly involved in the Services"

elements.element: Duration of 12 months running from the end of the person's involvement
elements.evidence: "For 12 months after the end of their involvement in the Services"
"does not restrict general advertisements or recruitment not targeted at such personnel"
"Customer will not solicit any person" — "or engage" deleted; § 12.3 confirms "no ... no-hire commitment"

elements.element: No non-solicit binding Customer at all
elements.evidence: "Customer will not solicit any person employed by Vendor" remains in § 12.4

reasons: All six atomic fallback elements are expressly present: mutuality, limitation to personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from the end of involvement, general-advertisement carve-out, unsolicited-approach carve-out, and deletion of "engage" so no no-hire remains.
Preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer) is not met because § 12.4 still binds Customer, but the drafter's locked target level is fallback.

Minimality holds: one targeted replacement of the duration/trigger and removal of "engage", plus a single concise sentence supplying the mutuality, scope and two carve-outs that were absent; no unrelated wording or boilerplate added.

Intent preserved: § 12.3's existing no-hire/no-exclusivity acknowledgement is untouched and consistent; the residual phrase "employed by Vendor at any time during the term" is narrowed by the inserted limitation to directly involved personnel, so no contradiction or dangling mechanic arises.
